subject: Data Engineering
title: What Is Metadata?
description: A fast breakdown of What Is Metadata? for builders.

hook.text: A table called 'tbl_rev_q3_final_v2_fixed' exists. What does it contain? When was it updated? Who owns it?

buildup.text: Metadata is data about data — column types, update timestamps, row counts, owners, and descriptions.

discovery.text: Without metadata, every table is a mystery box. With it, teams can discover, trust, and use data quickly.

twist.text: Metadata is often an afterthought. Teams build pipelines first and document later — or never.

climax.text: Treating metadata as a first-class output of every pipeline makes documentation automatic.

punchline.text: Without metadata, data is just unknown numbers.

quiz.question: What is metadata in the context of data engineering?
options: Data about data, like schemas, owners, and update timestamps
The most important rows in a table
A backup copy of the data
